title: French television biography filmed by J. C. Averty
summary: Last year in France he was filmed for a French TV musical biography directed by J. C. Averty, though the release may take years.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: -- and last year when I was in France, they made a shot of my -- what was it?
It was done by J. C. Averty.
J. C. Averty. He's a director of a studio, of my --
Excuse me. 'A Musical Biography of Barney Bigard' for French television. And we haven't heard
whether it's been shown over there yet -- Or not.
-- or not. But it was really a fantastic thing.

Yeah. And it was a hot day that day, so they had to bring us some spirits to keep us going and which we -- it was pretty nice, and it should come out all right. But you know the Frenchmen, it takes them so long to do anything. I mean, it may come out in three years, four years, five years. Who knows? But it was worth it. I enjoyed doing it.
